title: Bounded immutable connection shard placement verification
scope: Verify independently forceable legacy_current and bounded_power_of_two_choices placement, one connection-registration boundary, immutable lifetime routing, bounded active-count observations, exact rollback accounting, unified provenance, authoritative safety fallback, shutdown and disposal behavior, and force-legacy rollback without making a performance or active-behavior claim.
verification_method: Canonical SpecTrace validation, deterministic requirement-home tests, composed v10-base plus v11-placement schema validation, semantic latch validation, and focused host, listener, endpoint, registration, disposal, shutdown, package, and unified-evidence correctness tests.
preconditions: Every adjacent applied policy remains legacy_current.
The stopped 55,658-epoch single-axis transform remains diagnostic_incomplete and untouched.
Performance measurement, campaigns, transforms, ML, CI work, push, active_internal, and production activation remain unauthorized.
procedure: Validate the Stage 4 specification, architecture, work item, and verification artifacts against the canonical model and reciprocal links.
Build the affected runtime, test project, and raw host in Release before testing.
Verify closed legacy_current and bounded_power_of_two_choices values plus invalid closed-set rejection.
Verify disabled, observe-only, shadow, forced-legacy, and forced-bounded-choice identities, reasons, safety, boundary, latch, fallback, and versions.
Verify legacy_current uses exact handle modulo and bounded choice compares exactly two distinct candidates with the legacy tie break.
Verify the route remains immutable after registration while active counts change.
Verify duplicate registration, runtime ownership failure, unregister, disposal, and shutdown preserve route and counter correctness.
Verify missing, stale, saturated, contradictory, invalid, out-of-domain, lifecycle, and single-shard state fall back under forcing.
Verify a late sink receives the immutable decision and a throwing sink cannot affect registration or routing.
Verify unified evidence v11, unified raw v11, and manifest v12 schemas compose with the complete v10 base projection.
Verify every exported epoch contains one placement record with a nonzero handle, valid shard index, and stable connection-lifetime identity.
Verify simultaneous behavior-distinct campaign forcing remains rejected and all adjacent axes apply legacy_current.
Run focused host/listener sharding, endpoint registration, package, cancellation, disposal, shutdown, and unified tests.
Confirm no performance, campaign, transform, ML, CI, push, active_internal, or production action occurred.
expected_result: connection_shard_placement is observable, shadowable, independently forceable, unified-row represented, guarded, immutable for the connection lifetime, and force-legacy rollback tested; active-count accounting remains correct across failure and unregister; and no migration, performance, or active decision is introduced.
status_summary: Focused implementation verification is clean: the runtime and endpoint seam, immutable connection-lifetime latch, exact active-count rollback, listener and client propagation, unified v11 evidence, manifest v12 composition, 19 axis cases, and 73 affected placement, host, listener, package, and unified cases pass in Release. The raw host builds cleanly, and all four Stage 4 SpecTrace artifacts pass the canonical model and reciprocal trace checks. Measurement and active behavior remain frozen.
